programme.desc: S22 E8 — Tree Strike Terror In November 1995, American Airlines flight 1572 clips the tops of trees along Peak Mountain Ridge and strikes an instrument landing system antenna at Bradley International Airport in Hartford, Conn.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S22 E9 — Pitch Black An Illinois turboprop crashes in bad weather, and investigators eventually uncover a fatal assumption and deadly decision.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.
programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.desc: S1 E8 — The Night Shift Thord has to keep the road open during heavy snowfall. Bjørn is on the mountain rescuing a truck when a car tries to bypass him and gets stuck.
programme.title: Ice Road Rescue

programme.desc: S1 E9 — Fishy Business Bjørn helps a car whose fuel has frozen before the road is forced to close. Thord works tirelessly to keep the trucks moving and the road open.
programme.title: Ice Road Rescue

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Fire And Ice In Voss, a fish truck has gone off the road, and it is up to Ove and his crew to get it back up before the valuable fish go bad.
programme.title: Ice Road Rescue

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Canada's Wilderness Railroad Following railroads across interesting scenery through the lens of aerial photography and with a focus on engineering challenges. The Winnipeg-Churchill train crosses the difficult landscape of Manitoba.
programme.title: World's Greatest Train Journeys From Above

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Darjeeling Himalayan Railway Connecting the plains of New Jalpaiguri to the foothills of the Himalayas, the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway runs through dizzying loops and zigzags to conquer the world's tallest mountain range.
programme.title: World's Greatest Train Journeys From Above

programme.desc: S18 E7 — Free Fall On 26 April 1994, China Airlines Flight 140 enters an aerodynamic stall at low altitude and crashes approximately 100 metres away from the runway while on final approach to Nagoya Airport in Nagoya, Japan.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S18 E8 — Deadly Inclination Swiss investigators must determine how a seasoned Alitalia crew flew their DC-9 into the ground on 14 November 1990. The aircraft was just a few miles short of a Zurich runway and crashed during the final approach.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S18 E9 — Deadly Go Round The mystery deepens for investigators as they examine the debris of China Airlines Flight 140, which crashed into the ground at Japan's Nagoya Airport in 1994.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S26 E5 — Peril Over Pakistan On 28 July 2010, Airblue Flight 202 crashed into the Margalla Hills while attempting to land at Benazir Bhutto International Airport in poor weather conditions, killing all 152 people on board.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S15 E10 — Carnage In Sao Paulo Ninety-five people died when TAM Airlines flight 402 crashed seconds after take-off in 1996. Experts investigate what went so tragically wrong.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S25 E5 — Powerless Plunge Just moments after takeoff, a Loganair cargo flight from Edinburgh loses both engines and crashes into the icy North Sea.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S6 E3 — Great Britain This aerial tour of Great Britain uncovers Wales's biggest castle, a migration of Highland cattle, and monster bridge-making machine.
programme.title: Europe From Above

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Anne Boleyn Executed on charges of adultery and treason, Anne Boleyn is often remembered as the 'harlot'. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow explore evidence that reveals a different Anne, whose ideas transformed England and whose reputation deserves reassessing.
programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads

programme.desc: S1 E9 — Chinook Discover the Chinook, the heavy-lift helicopter that rewrote the rules of aviation. Born in the 1950s America, the Chinook entered service in Vietnam. Its bent airframe and tandem rotors gave it a huge lift capability.
programme.title: Planes That Changed History

programme.desc: S6 E1 — Operation Cobra The story of the Allied forces trying to free Europe by fighting Nazi fanatics until the last man is standing.

programme.desc: Former slave labourers at the Sobibor death camp in German-occupied Poland discuss their lives as prisoners and share the story of their desperate and courageous escape on 14 October 1943.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

I Now Pronounce You Dead 01/07/2022: A man's double life leads to a shocking murder.

S45 E16 — What the Little Girl Saw A hockey player, a brutal murder and a shocking witness -- the victim's young daughter.
A Model Murder 02/24/23: An Instagram model's relationship with an older man turns deadly.
S46 E06 — Baby Holly Found Forty years after a young couple is murdered, their true identities lead to a shocking twist.
S46 E07 — First Divorced Then Dead A beloved professor is murdered; inside the trial.
S46 E08 — The One That Got Out Multiple women are murdered during a Texas police hunt for a serial killer.
S46 E09 — Diary of a Killer When a beloved mother is killed, police uncover clues in the accused killer's diary.

S46 E11 — Three Shots in the Dark When a pro athlete is murdered, police embark on an international chase for the killer.
S46 E13 — There Is a Monster in Me When a woman is killed in small-town Texas, a secret diary reveals the killer's motive.
S46 E15 — The Murderer in the Minivan Three women -- one missing, one murdered, one kidnapped -- and the clues leading to a killer.
S46 E16 — Sealed With a Kill An inside look at an undercover investigation involving conspiracy, escorts and murder for hire.

S46 E17 — Love. Honor. Betray. John Quiñones reports on the story of a young husband, father and soldier murdered while at home for the holidays; interrogation tapes and extensive police body camera footage reveal a twisted tale of heartache and greed.

S46 E19 — Killer on Campus A Florida university campus is on edge when a student disappears; police say love, lies and obsession led to murder; a new witness comes forward with a claim that could potentially overturn the case.
S46 E21 — Highway Hunter When four young women go missing, police hunt for a serial killer roaming the interstate; John Quiñones explores the families' quests for answers.

S46 E23 — Am I Next? When a young couple is found dead, police learn they were involved in an online feud and uncover a deadly catfishing scheme; "20/20" untangles the web of lies and unmasks the unlikely mastermind behind the murders.
S46 E25 — 'Til Death Do Us Part A beloved small-town minister is found killed in his family home and his wife and three children are nowhere to be found.

S46 E27 — Forever 17 When two teen girls never make it home after a night out, authorities discover their dead bodies in the trunk of a car; detectives go to exhaustive lengths to identify the killer, but it takes decades before they zero in on a very unlikely suspect.
S46 E28 — The Unkindest Cut When a beloved celebrity hairstylist is found murdered in his home, authorities consider whether it was a burglary gone wrong or something more sinister.

S46 E30 — Follow the Fingerprints In the eyes of the law, a man killed his first wife, but his second wife thinks he is innocent; incredible new developments take this investigation in a completely new direction, as John Quiñones reports on the crime, the courts and the confession.
S46 E32 — Night Terror A couple is murdered inside their home, possibly by someone trying to hide a secret double life.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

programme.title: Homicide: Life on the Street

programme.title: Homicide: Life on the Street

programme.desc: S7 E4 — The Twenty Percent Solution A woman gives the homicide unit a videotape recorded by her mystery-writer husband, alleging his literary agent is responsible for murdering him. programme.title: Homicide: Life on the Street

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Never the New Period drama set against the backdrop of the American Gilded Age, following the fortunes of Marian, a young woman who moves from rural Pennsylvania to New York City after the death of her father to live with her wealthy aunt. Starring Louisa Jacobson, Christine Baranski and Denée Benton.
programme.title: The Gilded Age

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Money Isn't Everything Tom Raikes visits New York as Peggy seeks advice, Oscar van Rhijn homes in on Gladys Russell and drama rips through a charity bazaar.
programme.title: The Gilded Age

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Face the Music An unfortunate development finds George's new rail station under threat, and Marian continues to see Mr Raikes despite Agnes' warnings.
programme.title: The Gilded Age

programme.desc: S1 E4 — A Long Ladder In the aftermath of a tragedy, George agrees to help Bertha, and a visit has a lasting impact on the staff of Russell house.
programme.title: The Gilded Age

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Charity Has Two Functions As Bertha, Marian and Aurora visit Dansville to hear Clara Barton speak, Marian's interest in Mr Raikes grows.
programme.title: The Gilded Age

programme.desc: S1 E6 — There Is a War Coming Duke prepares for his long-awaited shot at revenge, while others take matters into their own hands. Drama, starring Howard Charles.

Arrogant analyst Martin Schmidt convinces the President to retaliate by bombing an al-Qaeda training camp in Khost, Afghanistan. Alec Baldwin guest stars, with Jeff Daniels, Peter Sarsgaard and Virginia Kull.
programme.title: The Looming Tower

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Mercury Continuing to keep information from the FBI, Schmidt is fired from Alec Station. Diane makes an important discovery about the owner of the phone number al-Owhali gave Chesney. O'Neill searches for solace in his faith as his personal and professional lives crumble before him. Jeff Daniels, Peter Sarsgaard and Wrenn Schmidt star.
programme.title: The Looming Tower

programme.title: Billions

Spring is in the air, and the town is a hive of activity as skippers return their pleasure yachts to the water after winter in the dry dock, while the pressure is on for Brixham to look its best for the arrival of Princess Anne, who will officially open the new £20million fish market, and the start of the summer season.

programme.desc: S1 E2 Brixham hosts its annual Pirate Festival, paying tribute to Devon's colourful maritime history, while fisherman Nathan sets off in search of a lucrative catch.

programme.title: Billions

programme.desc: Violence has been outlawed in the politically correct regime of 2032, and the only weapons in existence are consigned to a museum, but when an escaped psychopath heads straight for the museum, the authorities decide the only effective recourse they have is to thaw out a violent, cryogenically frozen cop.
programme.title: Demolition Man

programme.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.
programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves

programme.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.
programme.title: Lake Placid

programme.desc: Frustrated writer Jack Torrance takes a job as the winter caretaker at the ominous, mountain-locked Overlook Hotel so that he can write in peace. When he arrives there with his wife and son, they learn that the previous caretaker had gone mad. Slowly Jack becomes possessed by the evil, demonic presence in the hotel. Based on the book by Stephen King.
programme.title: The Shining

programme.desc: A kung fu expert is assigned to penetrate an island fortress to destroy an opium and white slavery empire.
programme.title: Enter the Dragon

programme.desc: On a remote island, a wealthy entrepreneur creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening the attraction to the public, he invites a top palaeontologist, palaeobotanist, mathematician/theorist, and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park. Their park visit is anything but tranquil as the park's security system breaks down, and the prehistoric creatures break out.
programme.title: Jurassic Park

programme.desc: Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.
programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park

programme.desc: Two detectives are in search of a serial killer who seems to be exacting retribution for the seven deadly sins. programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption

programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.
programme.title: A Clockwork Orange

programme.desc: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fuelled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.
programme.title: Scarface

programme.desc: From chart-topping singers to scene-stealing screen stars, this week's edition of The Cinema List celebrates musicians turned actors, featuring Dreamgirls and Wicked: For Good.
programme.title: The Cinema List: Musician Actors

programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.
programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

programme.desc: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking

programme.desc: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too

programme.desc: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now

programme.desc: An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.
programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.
programme.title: The Man With Two Brains

programme.desc: Danny Noonan, a teen down on his luck, works as a caddy at the snob-infested Bushwood Country Club to raise money for his college education. In an attempt to gain votes for a college scholarship reserved for caddies, Noonan volunteers to caddy for a prominent and influential club member. Meanwhile, Danny struggles to prepare for the high pressure Caddy Day golf tournament while absorbing New Age advice from wealthy golf guru Ty Webb.
programme.title: Caddyshack

programme.desc: When the transition is being made from silent films to `talkies', everyone has trouble adapting. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E15 — The Large Hadron Collision Leonard is invited to Switzerland on Valentine's Day to see the world's largest particle accelerator. Sheldon is gutted when Leonard asks Penny to go with him, as a Valentine's Day treat, instead of him. Sheldon tries to coerce the couple into letting him take Penny's place, will they relent?
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E16 — The Excelsior Acquisition Sheldon is summoned to court for driving through a red light while taking Penny to hospital in an earlier episode. He misses meeting Stan Lee, creator of 'Spider-Man', at the comic book store and riles the judge so much that he ends up in prison. Penny feels so guilty that Sheldon has missed out on the opportunity to meet Stan Lee that she finds out his home address and takes Sheldon there.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E17 — The Precious Fragmentation The gang squabble over a ring which they believe was used in 'The Lord of the Rings'. Leonard wants to give it back to its original owner, Koothrappali wants to sell it so that he can buy a jet ski, but Sheldon becomes obsessed with the ring and starts to turn into Gollum from The Lord of the Rings. Can the guys reach an agreement and will Sheldon return to normal?
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: S3 E18 — The Pants Alternative Sheldon has been awarded a prestigious prize by the university but is scared of collecting the gong at a ceremony because he knows he'll have to give a speech. Penny tries to gee Sheldon up using rousing references to "X-Men" and Leonard and Koothrappali offer psychological guidance without much success. On the night, Sheldon's nerves get the better of him, and he has a drink before going on stage.
programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.desc: Satire on the intrusive nature of television in which a man's apparently idyllic lifestyle is turned on its head when he discovers the shocking truth about his perfect hometown and the people who live there. Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael shows us how to make an impossibly delicious brunch menu of Parm Frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that you can serve all day.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Asian chef Kinsan and Laura make Japanese Vegetable Tempura in the Market Kitchen. Laura then prepares Chicken Schnitzel with Mushroom Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Come spring, Lidia gets very excited to visit the market. The colour, the aromas, that first harvest, it all ignites her creative side to get cooking after a long winter.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden dives at sunrise for sea urchins, then he's off to a local farmers' market to buy mushrooms, grab some famous donuts, and cook for his friends on their goat farm.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: Hot and spicy is all the rage in today's episode. Rebecca Veale is back in the kitchen for crispy chilli stir fry, and Simon brings a spicy salad loaded with mouthwatering roasted radishes.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver arrives on the tiny Sicilian island of Marettimo. Here he meets fisherman Giovanni - the owner of one of Sicily's best restaurants - who has Jamie work as his assistant in his eatery.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a beautifully buttery night on The Cook Up, as Adam is joined by croissant connoisseur Kate Reid and acclaimed chef Giovanni Pilu.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: This traditional Tuscan dish is perfect for a summer's late lunch to carry you into an evening of relaxing. Michael Symon revamps some grilled chicken by glazing it with some floral vermouth.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula shows us how to make her version of steak diane by substituting the steak with a collop of venision which she roasts and serves with sauteed potatoes. She demonstrates how to smoke a chicken.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Chef Luke Nguyen visits the beachside town of Nha Trang, a coastal town abundant with fresh seafood - and prepares char grilled lobster right on the beach.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke heads to a coastal town to teach cooking skills to disabled children, who learn how to prepare fish cakes; Luke visits to a farmyard to learn how a family creates fresh tofu; local monks demonstrate how to cook a vegetarian meal.

programme.title: Planet Bbq
programme.desc: This show gives grilled and smoked vegetables their due; tandoori cauliflower with coriander mint chutney, squash gratin with habanero chiles, and Mexican pit-roasted lamb.

programme.title: Fun'q With Spencer Watts
programme.desc: The sun is shining and Spencer is turning up the heat, cooking delicious grilled food perfect to be served on a bun. He shares his secrets to the perfect grilled veggie burger and sesame meatloaf.

programme.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
programme.desc: Nornie journeys to Hammond Island to explore its unique blend of cultures and rich history.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Grown Up Tomato Soup And Grilled Cheese
programme.desc: This classic combo from your youth gets an adult makeover and will make your mouth water. Rachael shows us her version of a creamy tomato soup and a spicy grilled cheese.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Guest chef Adam D'Sylva kicks off with his delicious Vietnamese Chicken and Bean Salad. Laura follows with Lamb and Feta Koftas with Flatbread and Yoghurt.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia always says, Let the ingredients shine! When you choose quality ingredients, it's best to let them speak for themselves.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden learns about regenerative farming at a cherry farm and a cattle property, with alpacas and a famous winery visit thrown in, and ends the day with a picture-perfect campfire meal.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: This episode of Freshly Picked is filled with delicious sweet treats. Monica Mignone returns with her carrot cake slice. Simon makes yummy biscuits with maple and tahini.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie heads north to the mountains of Le Marche - a relatively unexplored region next door to Umbria - to stay with a family of hunters.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Celebrated pastry chef and chocolatier Kirsten Tibballs presents an array of incredibly clever and innovative tricks, tips and cheats to bring the wow factor to home baking.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Learn how to whip up Justine's delicious homemade sub or her hearty Italian ratatouille on today's episode. Also, ex-Masterchef contestant, Emelia Jackson, drops in.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Two trailblazing guests, chef Analiese Gregory and hospitality head honcho Ibby Moubadder join Adam in the kitchen to celebrate the power of some simple sides.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick journeys through southern England. He takes in the rather pungent Garlic festival on the Isle of Wight, visits a chilli fiesta, and tastes the once extinct Blue Vinny cheese.

programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella shares her culinary talent as she presents delicious Italian-inspired food. First, Nigella reveals a secret passion for one of the tastes of Italy with her dark and deviant liquorice pudding.

programme.desc: Donal and Max are steering their way to the Ancient East, a land of myths and legends and food traditions but first up Donal takes to the sky to battle a great fear of heights at Carlingford Adventure.
